angles.drive: The subject nobody else is studying is the one you cannot leave alone. Earth loads your mind past what the day uses, and the surplus hunts for stranger material. You take it in because it feeds you, or because nobody can check your work there. It fills you, and it never finishes.

Pulling back is where you rest, long before it is any kind of reaction. Company drains a battery in you that solitude recharges, and the door drifts toward closed on its own schedule. Nothing has to go wrong first. The pulling back is the baseline.
